metadata.title: उराँव परिवार में पका ख़ास बंडा मीट | झारखंडी बंडा | The Tribal Kitchen | Tribal Food
metadata.description: The Oraon tribe, one of the largest tribal groups in India, is known for its rich cultural heritage, with food playing a central role in their traditions. Pork is a staple in their cuisine, deeply embedded in their everyday life and celebrations. During our visit to an Oraon village in the Lohardaga district of Jharkhand, we were warmly welcomed by a tribal family. They graciously shared their culinary traditions, preparing pork in the most authentic, traditional way. The slow-cooked meat, infused with local spices and herbs, reflected the simplicity and depth of their food culture, offering us a true taste of Oraon heritage.
